InitialDialog.dialog: Oh great, enemies AND that guy. Look at him — arms everywhere, like he’s trying to signal for a parade.
REDZ don’t usually wander this far out. What are they doing here

EndingDialog.dialog: AAAH—finally! I’ve been windmilling my arms for hours! Thought maybe it’d make me fly… nope.
Ha! Look at you, all arms and no brakes. Maybe try pedals next time.
…REDZ came outta nowhere. Shot me clean off my course. What are they even doing way out here?
REDZ don’t just patrol empty star systems. Feels like they’re hunting for something...
Could they... be after my bike?
Wait a sec... look , what are they doing?
